mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (below 5.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative earnings outlooks and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 35% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a period of slowing industrial production (annual growth rate below 0.5%), the risk of manufacturing slowdown increases, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO annual growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable inflation rate (CPIAUCSL below 2.5%) signals reduced risk of aggressive monetary tightening, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 100,000 monthly additions signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is below 100,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative earnings outlooks and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 35% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a period of strong retail sales growth (RSAFS monthly growth above 0.8%), consumer spending supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS monthly growth exceeds 0.8%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
